name: blaze_rod
description: Near a fortress in the Nether, kill blazes for a rod.
goal: You are in the Nether near a fortress. Find it, find blazes (they spawn around blaze spawners in the fortress), kill them and get at least 1 blaze rod. Keep the rod safe: dig in when hurt, don't fight over lava. Say 'got a rod' when you have one.
